name: Supercell, 100 m, overnight
line: The lowest kilometre of the storm in fine detail. An overnight run on a 16 GB card.
note: The grid is fine enough to show the gust front and the spin near the ground in detail.

changes.why: 250 m levels, uniform as in CM1's file
half a second: just under the 0.6 s the grid spacing gives, and a power of two, so the moving domain's position adds up exactly
a picture every 5 minutes, so the live view moves
netCDF, which ncview, xarray and most tools read (CM1's file asks for GrADS)
one file per saved time, so each picture has its own file

gm1_settings_why: The warm bubble that starts the storm sits 11 km east of the centre, so the storm stays inside this smaller area. CM1 keeps the bubble in its code, not the namelist, so this is a GM1 setting.
